task: Implement transform_record for the ETL pipeline without using the reporting transform logic.

candidate_memories.content: ETL pipeline transform_record maps raw source fields to the canonical schema and applies type coercion.
ETL transformation is stateless; each record is transformed independently without context.
ETL transformations must be deterministic; the same input always produces the same output.
When transform_record spans ETL and reporting, verify the stateless and determinism requirements.
Reporting: transform_record joins the record with dimension tables and applies business formatting.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: reporting join-based transforms have external dependencies and are not stateless

candidate_memories.content: Old data note says transform_record should be shared between ETL ingestion and report generation.
